question: Which donor, library, annotation and assay identities and coverage support bounded observational description of the GSE136831 human lung atlas?
decision: Qualify source joins and coverage before a separate reviewed numerical contract; do not infer a validated NAM identity from generic macrophage labels.
strongest_rival: Barcode misalignment, repeated libraries treated as independent donors, absent clinical covariates and capture-limited cell populations can create invalid comparisons or source attribution.
discriminator: Check exact barcode order, source donor-disease/library-donor mappings and metadata coverage independently; inspect matrix header and native human gene mapping without fitting expression outcomes.
exposure_record: Exposed to the atlas publications, prior Ravel GSE136831 summaries, three source metadata/header rows and the matrix dimensions before freeze. This is qualification, not unexposed confirmation. No new human expression comparison has yet run.
biological_unit: Deposited Subject_Identity donor, with Library_Identity and captured cells nested; mappings are to be verified.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells and any repeated libraries nest within source-defined subjects. GSE136831 has already been reused in Ravel; no independent cohort validation is claimed.
population_and_selection: All four cached public GSE136831 files for Control, IPF and COPD. No outcome-based cell/donor exclusions; metadata identities and annotations are audited as deposited.
contrast: Source-label, unit and assay qualification only; no disease expression or functional effect is estimated.
endpoint: Donor/library/annotation coverage, barcode order, matrix dimensions, native human gene-ID mapping and missing clinical covariates.
methods: Pandas metadata census and grouping, independent standard-library CSV Counter coverage check; inspect integer MatrixMarket header only; check candidate exact human-symbol uniqueness without orthologue imputation.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing source identities or inconsistent joins stop execution. Absent annotated neutrophils or scarce cells restrict ARG1 attribution to captured populations. Unrecorded clinical covariates remain unavailable.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or multiple-testing claims.
precision_basis: Metadata census of available files; no population uncertainty or power claim.
interpretation_limit: A public donor identity and passing joins permit description, not causal independence from disease/capture/covariates, validated human NAM identity, tissue-wide transcript source dominance or biological acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/order/identity/dimension conflicts and preserve failure records. No expression fits, mouse/infection analysis, engineering protocol or biological intervention in this qualification.
amendment_reason: New separately authorized human observational continuation after completed source-v2 metadata correction; this qualification does not resume restricted mouse/infection analyses.
